f2836326-503f-4258-9a7c-0aa0463414a0.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter, i.price FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), agg AS (SELECT quarter, SUM(price) AS gmv FROM q GROUP BY quarter) SELECT MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1') AS q1_gmv, MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q2') AS q2_gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q2') - MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1')) / NULLIF(MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1'), 0), 2) AS change_pct FROM agg LIMIT 1000

c48b7eeb-f591-4d1d-8035-5bb5cfd05199.sql: WITH q2 AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), per_order AS (SELECT r.order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_reviews, (SELECT MAX(n) FROM per_order) AS max_reviews_per_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n = 2) AS orders_with_2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n = 3) AS orders_with_3 LIMIT 1000

d3a0a9cd-2127-4686-b7b0-51553b1f3fc0.sql: WITH q2 AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), agg AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2) AS orders, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id) AS reviewed_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id) AS review_rows) SELECT orders, reviewed_orders, review_rows, review_rows - reviewed_orders AS rows_minus_orders, ROUND(100.0 * review_rows / NULLIF(reviewed_orders, 0), 2) AS pct_overcount, ROUND(100.0 * reviewed_orders / NULLIF(orders, 0), 2) AS review_rate_pct FROM agg LIMIT 1000
